CustomField.description: Picklist (Clone, Copy, Duplicate) supplying the Clone action's button text for Repeater and Table sections. Passed as clone-button-label to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Only takes effect when Enable Clone Action is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose the wording for the duplicate-row button, such as Clone, Copy, or Duplicate. Requires Enable Clone Action to be on.
CustomField.label: Clone Button Label
